items.t: Said children should not be forced to call somebody something they're not, in reference to legislation.
items.q: “Children should not be forced to call somebody something they’re not,” Rep. Brandon Ler said regarding the legislation last February.

items.t: Said, with Senate President Matt Regier, that judicial reform was already a top priority for Republican lawmakers.
items.q: “Judicial reform was already a top priority for Republican lawmakers,” Regier and Ler said, warning the justices to “buckle up.”
